branch_title: Joey Takes a Piece Without Asking

selected_option.choice_text: Reach over and take a piece from Mia's pile without asking

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Joey, you took my toy, huh. I still need a little more space. And those are the blocks I was using too.

sequence.text: Joey didn't notice Mia needed more space. Mia cried, and playing wasn't as fun anymore.
